exclusion_rules: none beyond the frozen heldout_v1_1 exposure audit

inclusion_rules.execution_order: dependency-group units ordered by SHA-256('20260930|group-order|dependency_group'); questions by question_id within a unit; system order per question by SHA-256('20260930|system-order|dataset|question_id|system')
inclusion_rules.musique_full: equal-probability sample of dependency groups (both answerable and insufficient variants kept together): lowest SHA-256('20260930|sample|musique_full|dependency_group')
inclusion_rules.qasper: equal-probability sample of questions without replacement: lowest SHA-256('20260930|sample|qasper|question_id')
inclusion_rules.stratification: by dataset only (fixed 50/50); no stratification on answerability, evidence or outcomes
